ORAL JUDGMENT Crl.P No.102258/2023 is filed by accused No.1 and Crl.P No.101829/2023 is filed by accused Nos.2 to 9.

Both the petitions are filed praying to quash the proceedings in CC No.1295/2023 pending on the file of Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Bailhongal, registered for offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323, 504, 506 and 109 r/w Section 149 of IPC.
2.
The accusation made in the charge sheet column No.17 is that the accused No.1 has married the respondent No.1 about 12 years ago.
The accused No.1 at the instigation of accused Nos.2 to 9 used to quarrel with respondent No.1 and used to harass and ill-treat her.

It is further stated that on 14.12.2022 at about 7:30 pm accused No.1 at the instigation of accused Nos.2 to 9 under intoxication, abused respondent No.1 in filthy language and asked her to go to her parents house with children and held her hand assaulted her with hand and kicked her on her stomach and made her to fall on the ground and gave her life threat.
On the basis of the said charge sheet allegations, a case came to be registered against the accused NC: 2024:KHC-D:11643 Nos.1 to 9 for the offences noted supra.
The proceedings of the criminal case are sought to be quashed in these petitions.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners would contend that the allegations made against the present petitioners is omnibus allegations and unnecessarily the other family members are dragged in this proceedings, even though there is no involvement.
On these grounds he prayed to allow the petition.

4. Learned counsel for respondent No.1 would contend that the accused Nos.2 to 9 instigated the accused No.1 to abuse, assault and ill-treat the respondent No.1 and therefore, the accused No.1 has ill-treated the respondent No.1, abused her, assaulted and kicked her and gave her life threat.
The charge sheet is registered against all the accused for the offence alleged against them.
On these grounds he prays to dismiss the petition.

5. Learned High Court Government Pleader would contend that the charge sheet material shows prima facie case against the petitioners for the offence alleged against them and there are no grounds for quashing the proceedings.
Having heard the learned counsels, the Court has perused the charge sheet material.

7. There is a specific allegation against the accused No.1 that on 14.12.2022 at about 7:30 pm, he abused the respondent No.1 in filthy language, assaulted her with hands, kicked her on stomach,
made her to fall on the ground and gave her life threat.
CW.4 and 5 are the eye-witnesses to the said incident.
Considering the said aspect there are no ground for quashing the proceedings against the accused No.1.
Chandragoud S/O Basanagoud Patil vs Smt. Roopa W/O Chandragoud Patil on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153363387/
5 8. Accused No.2 to 9 are the family members of accused No.1.
The accusation against them is that at their instigation, the accused No.1 used to quarrel with respondent No.1.
Except the said omnibus allegations there are no other allegations against accused Nos.2 to 9 of ill-treating the respondent No.1 etc.
There is no specific overt act alleged against the accused Nos.2 to 9.
How and what way they instigated the accused No.1 has not been stated either by the complainant i.e., respondent No.1 or the charge sheet witnesses.
Considering the said aspects, the proceedings against accused Nos.2 to 9 required to be quashed.

9. In the result, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:11643 ORDER i) Crl.P No.102258/2023 filed by accused No.1 is dismissed.
ii) Cr.P. No.101829/2023 filed by accused Nos.2 to 9 is allowed.

iii) The proceedings in CC No.1295/2023 pending on the file of the Principal Civil Judge and JMFC, Bailhongal, registered for offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 323, 504, 506 and 109 r/w Section 149 of IPC are quashed in so far as accused Nos.2 to 9 are concerned.

Sd/-
